title: Who Else Wants to Know?
subtitle: How AI could help strangers discover unexpected questions and fund the answers together.
abstract: AI could help people discover questions they hadn’t imagined, connect them with unfamiliar sources and measurement capabilities, and bring buyers together to fund new observations. This speculative essay explores that possibility through freight, weather and urban infrastructure examples. It considers how shared purchases can support lasting observation capability while buyers remain unknown to one another, and how funding choices shape which questions get investigated.
